name: KromiumBeforeDownloadListener
summary: Functional interface to dynamically resolve the target path before a download begins.

methods.name: onBeforeDownload
methods.signature: fun onBeforeDownload(item: KromiumDownloadItem, suggestedFileName: String): String?
methods.description: Intercepts a download request before it starts. Returns the absolute path where the file should be saved, null to use the default path, or an empty string "" to cancel the download.

parameters.name: suggestedFileName
parameters.description: The file name suggested by the server.
